# ParticleEmitter

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · struct

```csharp
public readonly struct ParticleEmitter : IEquatable<ParticleEmitter>
```

A running emission point in a [`ParticleSystem`](ParticleSystem.md), from [`ParticleSystem.CreateEmitter`](ParticleSystem.md#createemitter): it emits its system's effects continuously until it's stopped or their durations end.

## Remarks

A handle to one of the system's pooled emitter slots, so creating emitters allocates nothing once the pool has grown to the most that run at once. A handle to an emitter that has ended stays ended, even after its slot is reused: [`IsActive`](#isactive) is false, setting [`Position`](#position) or [`Scale`](#scale) does nothing, and [`Stop`](#stop) does nothing.

## Properties

### IsActive

```csharp
public bool IsActive { get; }
```

Whether it's still emitting.

### Position

```csharp
public Vector2 Position { get; set; }
```

Where it emits, in its system's space. Set it before each [`ParticleSystem.Update`](ParticleSystem.md#update) to move it; the particles of a frame spread along the path between.

### Scale

```csharp
public float Scale { get; set; }
```

Scales its effects' shapes, for the effects with [`ParticleEffect.ShapeScalesWithEmitter`](ParticleEffect.md#shapescaleswithemitter).

### TimeSeconds

```csharp
public float TimeSeconds { get; }
```

How long it has run, in seconds; 0 once it has ended.

## Methods

### Stop

```csharp
public void Stop()
```

Stops emitting; its particles live out their lives.

### Teleport

```csharp
public void Teleport(Vector2 position)
```

Moves it without emitting along the way, as [`Position`](#position) would for an effect that emits by distance: a respawn, or a jump across the screen, leaves no streak.
